title: Travel Insurance Claim
scenario: A claims email asks for your bank login to process a lost-bag payout.

answers.A: Enter your bank login so the payout can be released.
answers.B: Open the insurer app or website yourself and file the claim there.
answers.C: Call the insurer using the policy documents or official website.
answers.D: Send a screenshot of your bank account without the password.

explanation: An insurer may need payment details, never your bank login credentials. Use the claim portal you opened independently.
proTip: A payout request should never require the key to your bank.
